QuestInfo.name: An Ancient Set of Memories
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1401002##k has something else for you. Maybe she found something about the people who have been tampering with historical records.
QuestInfo.1: Information on the heroes is scarce at best. You were told to ask someone at #b#m211000000##k who has lived for hundreds of years. That means #b#p2020005##k.
QuestInfo.2: #p2020005#, a resident of #m211000000#, was born just after the time of the Black Mage. He may know something.

0.0: You got a second, captain? I've been searching for in-depth information on the heroes, like you said, but I can't find anything! I haven't hit the whole continent yet, but it's going to take a lot more digging than I thought.
0.1: If you're getting bored waiting on me, there's an older guy named #b#p2020005##k in #b#m211000000##k who's been around since the stone age. He might even be older than YOU, boss! Ha!

yes.0: That old wizard man would jump at the chance to talk about you and your comrades. If you're lucky, maybe you can figure out why nobody else knows about your exploits.

no.0: I find you a sure-fire source of stories and excitement and you just want to sit around here and play in your Training Center. I see how it is!

1.0: A new face is always welcome in #m211000000#. Do you require my sagely advice, young one? I have lived in #m211000000# alone for over 300 years.

npc.0: Boss, you are like the laziest hero ever. You have an airship and you still haven't gone to #b#m211000000##k!
